dedupe_keys.name: battery state estimation adversarial noise simulation benchmark

description: This benchmark contains simulated battery current and voltage perturbation traces for evaluating state-estimation resilience. University of New South Wales researchers use MATLAB/Simscape and a reinforcement-learning agent to produce high- and low-noise test cases affecting state-of-charge and state-of-health estimation. Mendeley version 2 lists four MAT files, pairing original and updated case files, free under CC BY 4.0. The article also discusses a validation configuration with a different battery and estimator, but its exact mapping to the four current files was not established. Coverage is synthetic battery-system responses, not an operating storage fleet or a calendar monitoring interval. Model dependence and unresolved version differences are limitations for transfer. Modellers could test defensive estimator sensitivity and fault-detection assumptions in storage simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is related, without verified estimator coupling. No noise file, adversarial agent or battery-control program was downloaded or executed.
